title: Claimed headline metric extraction answer
description: Structured-decoding contract for the paper_facts claimed_headline_metric field. The model returns the paper's OWN reported headline figure for one strategy as a {mean, t_stat, unit} object, plus a verbatim supporting quote, OR reports the paper silent. This is a transcription of what the paper claims -- never a computed or converted value. paper_facts (schema v1.1) are analysis-only extraction output: RQ1-scorable, consumed by the fidelity harness and the Reporter's numeric verifier, and the adapter NEVER reads them (Guard 2).

mean.description: The headline mean as printed, sign included.

t_stat.description: The reported t-statistic, sign matching the mean.

unit.description: The unit the mean is printed in. No conversion is performed.

value.description: The paper's claimed headline figure, or null when answered=false. All three components are required together: a mean without its t-statistic is not a valid answer.

quote.description: Verbatim span supporting the value; required when answered=true.
